app.name: Shelly-ALPM
app.one_liner: A modern, native Arch Linux package manager with unified GUI and CLI interfaces for managing official repos, AUR, and Flatpak packages.

screens.name: Package Search & Management
screens.purpose: Unified view to search, filter, install, update, and remove packages from official repos, AUR, and Flatpak.
primary_actions: Search packages by name or description
View package details including last updated date

screens.name: Preferences & Configuration
screens.purpose: Configure repository sources, default page, theming, and layout options.

rust_commands.name: fetch_arch_news
rust_commands.purpose: Retrieve and display Arch Linux news in correct chronological order.

rust_commands.name: install_package
rust_commands.purpose: Install a package using direct libalpm integration, supporting official, AUR, and Flatpak sources.

rust_commands.name: search_packages
rust_commands.purpose: Perform unified search across official repos, AUR, and Flatpak with support for hyphen-insensitive matching and description inclusion.

rust_commands.name: update_system
rust_commands.purpose: Check for and apply updates across all supported package sources, including handling offline update scenarios.

mvp_plan: week 1: Add CLI command scaffolding for install/update/search
week 1: Build unified search screen with filtering by source type
week 1: Display package list with last-updated column
week 1: Implement core libalpm integration for package operations
acceptance_tests: Arch Linux news items appear in correct reverse-chronological order (newest first).
Clicking an update notification opens the update interface and shows applicable updates.
Installing an AUR package does not trigger JsonException during build metadata parsing.
User can search for 'firefox' and find results from official repos, AUR, and Flatpak regardless of hyphens in package names.
